item.title: Designing a Distributed Email Delivery System at Scale (Gmail/Outlook)
item.description: Production-grade system design for global email — transactional outbox, Kafka delivery pipelines, SMTP relay, object-store attachments, Elasticsearch search, and 1.5B-user capacity planning.

item.title: Designing a Distributed Logging System at Scale
item.description: Production-grade system design for a Splunk/Logstash-scale distributed logging platform — multi-source ingestion, stream processing, multi-tier retention, search, and alerting.

item.title: Designing a Global Top-K Leaderboard & Real-Time Ranking System at Scale
item.description: Production-grade system design for global leaderboards — real-time score ingestion, Redis sorted sets, Kafka streaming, Flink windowing, regional partitioning, and sub-100ms top-K queries.

item.title: Designing a Social Graph & Feed Application at Scale
item.description: Production-grade system design for a Facebook/Instagram-scale social graph and feed platform — hybrid fan-out, polyglot persistence, celebrity pull paths, and sub-200ms feed delivery.

item.title: Designing a Real-Time Collaborative Text Editor at Scale
item.description: Production-grade system design for a Google Docs / Notion-scale collaborative editor — Operational Transformation, WebSockets, versioning, presence, and sub-100ms sync at 25M edit RPS.

item.title: Designing a Scalable Chat Application at Scale
item.description: Production-grade system design for a WhatsApp/Messenger-scale chat platform — real-time messaging, delivery receipts, group fan-out, presence, and zero message loss.
